completion_promises.criterion_text: tests/integration/test_rag_end_to_end.py runs in <30s against the fixture corpus
completion_promises.evidence: Created tests/integration/test_rag_end_to_end.py with three @pytest.mark.smoke tests. Each test asserts elapsed time < _MAX_TOTAL_SECONDS (30s) via time.monotonic guards. Full file actually runs in ~0.03s on this machine; observed pytest wall-clock for the file: '3 passed in 0.03s'. Fixture corpus is 4 chunks total (3 primary Macbeth + 1 secondary study-guide).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Retrieve-and-verify path produces the expected VerifierMetadata shape (one PrimaryMatch, one SecondaryRewrite)
completion_promises.evidence: test_retrieve_and_verify_macbeth_primary_and_secondary asserts len(metadata.primary_matches)==1 and len(metadata.secondary_rewrites)==1, plus metadata.fuzzy_corrections==[], cross_text_events==[], no_match_strips==[], and verifier_exception is False. The PrimaryMatch's citation_anchor is asserted to be PlayCitationAnchor with act=1 scene=7. The rewritten response is checked to contain '(1.7.' citation render and to NOT contain the original quoted secondary span (quotes stripped).
